title: Yellowed Peruvian Beef Kidney Wrap
description: A sour and indulgent Peruvian dish featuring beef kidney and rest-meat, wrapped in a corn husk, this satvik-friendly meal is a unique blend of flavors and textures. The glassy-jelly like texture comes from the use of aji amarillo pepper sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, puree the aji amarillo peppers, onion, garlic, and lime juice to make the sauce.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the beef kidney and rest-meat until browned.
Add the pepper sauce to the skillet and stir to coat the meat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the meat mixture onto a corn husk and folding the husk to enclose.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
